rule.status: post-hoc revision analyses requested by a simulated pre-submission review (17 Oct 2026); designed after all earlier results were known; exploratory; APNet and all earlier runs unchanged; every outcome reported

training.swa: 20 epochs, average of the last 8 (as APNet)
training.early: early stopping on validation balanced accuracy, at most 30 epochs, patience 6 (as the FINAL run)
training.ea: input = R^-1/2 of the subject's label-free mean covariance (as APNet)
training.train_global: input z-scored with training-fold statistics (no alignment)
training.seed_formula: random_seed + fold index + seed_offset + seed (as APNet's seeds)
training.recent_models: exactly the F.2 protocol of the same-protocol comparison, with the seed added

permutation.what: in each CMx7-MM fold, the (rating, label) pairs of the TRAINING recordings are shuffled among recordings of the same task; validation and test recordings are unchanged

test_time.saved: every model writes two sealed files: with test-time AdaBN (sealed_test.parquet) and without (sealed_test_noadabn.parquet)
test_time.options: fixed now, no selection: APNet variants use APNet's locked option per dataset ({'cmx7': 'center', 'cog': 'center'}); permuted EEGNet + EA + AdaBN [SWA] uses its locked option ({'cmx7': 'center', 'cog': 'none'}); the -centring variant uses 'none'; recent models use the options locked in fair_lock.json for seed 0 ({'f_cbra_ft': {'cmx7': 'center', 'cog': 'center'}, 'f_cbra_probe': {'cmx7': 'center', 'cog': 'center'}, 'f_conformer': {'cmx7': 'center', 'cog': 'center'}, 'f_shallow': {'cmx7': 'center', 'cog': 'center'}})

tests.H-R1 (M2): CMx7-MM: APNet (locked, seed 0) > APNet trained on within-task permuted labels (seed 0); one-sided Wilcoxon over the 30 held-out subjects, alpha 0.05. Reading: if not met, APNet's accuracy does not depend on within-task information
tests.R1-desc: pooled within-task Spearman rho of the expected level vs the rating, averaged over the 5 eligible tasks, true vs permuted, bootstrap CI over subjects; within-task balanced accuracy per task
tests.H-R2 (M1): per dataset: APNet re-run (abl_full) vs each leave-one-out variant (-EA, -SWA, -AdaBN, -centring); two-sided Wilcoxon over held-out subjects, Holm over the 4 variants within the dataset
tests.R2-desc: fully inductive variant (no EA, no test-time AdaBN, no centring; SWA kept) vs EEGNet (FINAL run) and vs the re-run; re-run vs locked APNet (reproducibility); one-class subjects of every variant
tests.H-R3 (M4): per dataset: APNet (3-seed) vs each recent model under APNet's protocol (3-seed ensemble); two-sided Wilcoxon, Holm over the 4 recent models within the dataset
tests.R3-desc: per-seed fold means and their SD for APNet, EEGNet + EA + AdaBN [SWA] and every recent model
tests.R5-desc: argmax-only ('none') and centred results for every protocol model (no training; addresses the transductive-test question)

rule.sealing: RV.3 hashes every sealed file of a family when the family is complete; RV.4 verifies the hashes before reading
